name: indexing-registry
description: This skill should be used to maintain the user's AI Registry — the registry/ knowledge bundle and its derived views (the REGISTRY.md dashboard, directory indexes, GENERATED blocks, and the visual HTML dashboard). Triggers: "update my registry", "refresh my registry", "lint my registry", "generate my dashboard", "what have I built", "show my AI inventory", after creating skills or agents, or when another framework skill's closing step calls for a maintenance pass. Also repairs stale or hand-edited derived views. If no registry/SCHEMA.md exists, route to the scaffolding-registry skill instead.
